role: Telecommunications operator and its Pakistani subsidiary
promise: Invest a further $1 billion in Pakistan over the next three years to expand 5G connectivity and digital services
description: VEON and its Pakistani subsidiary JazzWorld told Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif they would invest a further $1 billion in Pakistan over three years, expanding 5G rollout and digital services beyond telecom.
evidence: Announcement made during a leadership call with the Pakistani prime minister on September 10, 2026
